Executive Order 5595. April 9 , 1931
Executive Order
The Honorable Nicholas Longworth
As a mark of respect to the memory of the Honorable Nicholas Longworth , late
Speaker and Member of the House of Representatives of the United States , it is
hereby ordered that the flags on the White House and public buildings in the District
of Columbia and the State of Ohio be placed at half mast to-day and on the day of the
funeral service at Cincinnati , Ohio, Saturday, April 11 , 1931 .
HERBERT HOOVER
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
April 9, 1931 .
[No. 5595]

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The complete original directs half-mast flags only on April 9 and April 11, 1931. The final prescribed day expires at its close; April 12 is the first civil date on which no part of the command remains due. This is a temporal limit in the command itself, not a performance deadline. The sole paragraph creates no independent continuing institution, payment, or delegated power.
